evidence.quote: The COVID-19 pandemic is also causing significant economic hardship in Indian Country, affecting the many small businesses that are the backbone of tribal economies.
Only 20 percent of tribal small businesses reported they had enough cash on hand to maintain operations beyond a three-month period.
In September, the Federal Reserve Board unanimously voted to approve an Advance Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (ANPR) on the CRA.
